description: Project scaffold - React + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 app with routing, sidebar navigation, localStorage persistence layer, and data seeding (67 nurses + 108 health facilities)
steps: Initialize Vite React project at /projects/sandbox/PropelaPlatform/ with: npm create vite@latest . -- --template react. Install dependencies: react-router-dom, lucide-react, tailwindcss@4, @tailwindcss/vite.

Configure Tailwind CSS v4 in vite.config.js using the @tailwindcss/vite plugin. Create src/index.css with @import 'tailwindcss'. Add custom Propela brand colors as CSS custom properties: --propela-purple: #5B2D8E, --propela-purple-dark: #3D1D5E, --propela-purple-light: #F3EDF9, --propela-purple-mid: #7B4BAE. Include Poppins font from Google Fonts.

Create src/App.jsx with React Router setup. Routes: / (Dashboard), /nurses (Nurse Database), /acquisition (Acquisition Hub), /cohorts (Cohort Manager), /outreach (Outreach Log + Templates). Wrap in a layout with a sidebar.

Create src/components/layout/Sidebar.jsx - Desktop sidebar navigation with Propela purple gradient background (matching admin-dashboard.jsx design). Include: Propela logo at top, navigation items for all 5 modules with icons (using Lucide React), user avatar 'A' for Aya at bottom. Active state: rgba(255,255,255,0.15) background. Width: 220px.
Create src/components/layout/Layout.jsx - Main layout wrapper with sidebar on left, content area on right with F8F7FC background.
Create src/lib/storage.js - localStorage persistence layer. Functions: getData(key), setData(key, value), initializeData(). On first load (no data in localStorage), seed the nurse and facility data.

Create src/data/seedNurses.js - Generate 67 realistic nurse records matching the PRD nurse card field specification (Section 7.7). Include all fields: fullName, preferredName, pipelineStage, nextAction, readinessStatus, flags, email, contactNumber, gender, ageGroup, province, city, registeredWithSANC, registeredNurseInSA, sancNumber, sancAPCExpiry, sancAPCStatus, highestQualification, qualificationInstitution, yearsOfClinicalExperience, primaryClinicalSpecialty, additionalCertifications, employmentStatus, currentEmployer, validPassport, passportExpiryDate, efSetScore, efSetLevel, englishPts, oetStatus, scorecardFields (hospitalExp, sancStatus, qualifications, specialisation, financialReadiness, motivation, passport), cvScore (auto-calculated), finalScore (auto-calculated), tier (auto-calculated), shortlistDecision, cohortAssigned, agreementSigned, commitmentFeeStatus, source, motivations, questions, notesFlags, communicationLog[], photoURL, submittedAt. Use realistic South African nurse names, provinces (Gauteng, Western Cape, KwaZulu-Natal, Eastern Cape, etc.), specialties from PRD dropdown list. Distribute across pipeline stages realistically.

Create src/data/seedFacilities.js - Generate 108 health facility records for Track 1 Organisations (Type B). Fields per PRD Section 8.3: organisationName, organisationType (Health Facility), province, city, physicalAddress, primaryContactName, contactEmail, contactPhone, website, currentStage, lastContactDate, nextFollowUpDate, preferredChannel, nursesSourcedCount, internalRating, notes, healthcareGroup (Life Healthcare/Mediclinic/Netcare/Public/Independent/Other), facilityType (Private/Public), overview, outreachApproach, infoSessionHeld, infoSessionDate, nursesAttendingInfoSession, nursesConvertedToApplicants. Use real South African hospital names distributed across provinces.

Create src/lib/calculations.js - Implement auto-calculation utilities from PRD Appendix A: calculateCVScore(nurse) uses Hospital Exp x3 + SANC Status x3 + Qualifications x2 + Specialisation x1 then divides by sum of weights to get 0-5 scale. calculateFinalScore(nurse) uses all 8 criteria with full weighting / 15. calculateTier(finalScore) maps to tier names per PRD. calculateReadinessStatus(pipelineStage) per Appendix B.

Create src/lib/constants.js - All dropdown values from PRD: PIPELINE_STAGES (all stages from Section 7.2), NEXT_ACTION_VALUES (Section 7.7), READINESS_STATUSES, SPECIALTIES, PROVINCES (9 SA provinces), QUALIFICATION_TYPES, YEARS_EXPERIENCE, OET_STATUSES, COMMITMENT_FEE_STATUSES, HEALTHCARE_GROUPS, ORGANISATION_STAGES, TIERS, SHORTLIST_DECISIONS, SOURCE_OPTIONS, etc.

Create placeholder pages for each module: src/pages/Dashboard.jsx, src/pages/NurseDatabase.jsx, src/pages/AcquisitionHub.jsx, src/pages/CohortManager.jsx, src/pages/OutreachLog.jsx. Each should show the module title and a brief description. NurseDatabase will be expanded in FEAT-002.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without errors
App loads at localhost with sidebar navigation visible showing all 5 modules
Clicking each navigation item routes to the correct module page
localStorage contains seeded data on first load (67 nurses, 108 facilities)
Calculations utility correctly computes CV Score, Final Score, Tier, and Readiness Status
Tailwind CSS v4 is working with custom Propela purple color tokens
Poppins font loads and is applied as the base font
verification: Run npm install && npm run build and confirm zero errors
Run npm run dev in background, confirm app serves without crashing
